name: Amari Yuuta
source:
The eldest son of the Amari family who aspires to become a pastry chef.

Financially and emotionally, he is the backbone of the family, and everyone rely on him. Ever since he got a girlfriend, he has been constantly getting pushed around by his three younger sisters.
